title: Binance Will Add SKHYB Tokenized Securities as Collateral Assets
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Disclaimer:  bStocks are offered through an Approved Prospectus in the ADGM and are not offered in any other jurisdiction. No public offer is made outside of the ADGM. Tokenized Securities are available only to eligible users in permitted jurisdictions on a secondary market basis only. Find more about bStocks from this  announcement . Fellow Binancians, Binance Cross Margin, Portfolio Margin, and Portfolio Margin Pro will add  SK Hynix (SKHYB)  bStocks tokens as eligible collateral assets at  2026-07-13 13:30 (UTC) . The corresponding bStocks trading pairs will also be available for margin trading. Eligible users will be able to use these bStocks tokens as collateral in Margin, expanding their collateral options for margin trading. Notes: The above tokens have been added as collateral assets under Cross Margin, Portfolio Margin, and Portfolio Margin Pro only. Borrowing is not currently supported. Please stay tuned to future  Binance announcements  for updates. This feature is available to VIP 3 and above users in permitted jurisdictions only, and is not available to users in restricted regions. For the index price methodology of bStocks as collateral assets, please refer to the  bStocks Tokenized Securities Collateral Index Price Methodology . Users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies and regularly monitor their margin levels when using bStocks as collateral. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions.
